name: kanban-board

frames.best_why: All three columns are full and balanced with every card visible and no cursor over the board.

tagline: Three stacked columns of task cards that can be dragged between.
summary: A small kanban board with three columns of dark cards, each card carrying a coloured tag, a title, an assignee avatar and a due date. Cards lift while dragged and spring into their new column over a glowing drop line.
appearance: Three narrow columns on a black stage, each headed by a tiny status icon, a bold title and a count on the right. Under them sit rounded dark-grey cards with a small coloured tag pill, a two-line title, a round avatar and a date at the lower right.
behaviour: Dragging a card lifts it on a deeper shadow and leaves its slot open. Hovering another column tints that list blue and shows a glowing drop line, and releasing springs the card into the new stack; cards in Launched fade and get struck-through titles.
demo_content: Marketing tasks such as "Draft Q2 nurture email series" across Backlog, In flight and Launched.
search_phrases: move a card to another column
project tracker with tags and avatars
use_when: A small project or pipeline needs a compact draggable board of tasks inside a page.
avoid_when: Dragging relies on native HTML drag events, so the cards cannot be moved on a touch screen.
customise: Pass columns as an array of objects with title, status and cards, and handle drops with onDrop; tag colours, avatars and dates come from each card.
weight_why: Three columns of a few cards using spring and layout transforms around native drag events.

a11y.note: Cards are draggable but not focusable or keyboard-movable, and a move is not announced; the stagger delay is skipped under reduced-motion.

props.name: onDrop
props.type: (cardId: string, from: ColumnStatus, to: ColumnStatus) => void

issues: Tag labels are very small and low contrast against the dark cards.
There is no keyboard way to pick up or move a card.
polish_why: Careful card detail and a smooth spring layout; tiny type and mouse-only dragging hold it back.
